scope: Offline CPU-only optimization of handwritten Dart arithmetic storage. No native proprietary implementation, app/process/account/profile/network action or live timing was used.

originalAuthority.provenance: Unchanged retained independently executed original synthetic response/unprotect observations, pinned by content-key-observation.json nativeObservationSha256. Expected16-byte values are original outputs, not derived from Dart.
originalAuthority.standardAdapters: Unchanged from content-key-observation.json; this task replays retained original observations and executes no new original routine.

changes: Represent mapped but untouched pages with null; allocate zero-filled ByteData4096 on first access.
Retain the two most recently missed page mappings to avoid repeated Map lookups on the hot stack/data pages. A hit does not change page contents or mapping.
implementation.ownership: Storage is freshly owned by each _PlayPlayMath/key transform. No page, key result, persistent worker or cross-key arithmetic state is cached.
implementation.generatorOwnership: Storage helpers are handwritten. native_playplay_math_lift.py only replaces the generated part list in this file; no generator change is required.

profile.measurement: One instrumented private library copy, lazy-allocation variant before cache addition. Counts page() calls and allocated pages through the complete response/protected/unprotect path; exact16 output bytes compared to original vector4. The cache keeps that mapping/allocation behavior. Counts are not timings or whole-process memory.

byteReplay.comparison: All16 output bytes compared as32 hexadecimal characters against each retained independent original value; both runners throw immediately on mismatch.
byteReplay.coverageLimit: Synthetic retained cases are not exhaustive over128-bit inputs or every proprietary arithmetic branch. Worker replay uses default constants; scalar replay also includes both explicit original3072-byte tables.

timing.measurement: Separate fresh standalone Dart VMs, same host and sequential commands. Stopwatch excludes CLI/build hooks. Scalar includes construction+arithmetic; worker includes Isolate.run startup+arithmetic and uses the unchanged four-sample CPU warm-up.
timing.interpretation: Final scalar second-pass median27.942ms ->22.865ms (~18% lower); fresh-isolate last12 median28.2245ms ->25.5995ms (~9% lower). Warm-up2.692s ->2.484s and first unseen150.246ms ->145.225ms include JIT/process noise. Lazy-only timing did not establish a stable median win by itself.
limits: The live Flutter653–1593ms per-key delay was not reproduced or explained by this standalone comparison.
No claim of a stable cold JIT or live startup speedup; background scheduling, JIT branch coverage and GC remain uncontrolled.
No persistent-worker experiment or repeated bulk-copy optimization; existing worker and copy helpers remain unchanged.

preservedSemantics: map adds page mappings and never replaces existing page contents. A first read of a mapped page still sees zero bytes.
An unmapped page still throws the same StateError using the original requested address; it is never silently mapped.
Cached ByteData mappings stay valid because mappings only accumulate and pages are not deleted or replaced after allocation.
Scalar load/store code, little-endian widths, signed64 behavior, cross-page handling, bulk copying and return-byte ownership are unchanged.
verificationBoundary: Original arithmetic/protocol replay only; no general UI/component/lifecycle/full-suite tests, analyzer, formatter or AGENTS changes.
